defensiveAbilities.name: Horrifying Display
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The cythnophorian uses Fungal Possession

Effect All creatures in a 10ft Emanation must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1, or Sickened 2 on a critical failure. Affected creatures are Off-Guard for as long as they're sickened. Once a creature attempts this save, it's temporarily immune for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Creeping Death
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 round

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Stunned 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 6d6 Poison Damage damage and Confused (1 round)

Stage 4 6d6 Poison Damage damage and Controlled (1 round). A creature that dies while infected with creeping death immediately releases a burst of spores as if using the cythnophorian's Spore Cloud ability. If the corpse is not burned, it rises as the host of a new cythnophorian 12 hours later.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fungal Possession
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The cythnophorian's last action was a Strike that killed a target of size Medium or smaller

Effect The cythnophorian rips itself out of its current host and burrows its way into the corpse of its latest victim, regaining 3d4 Healing Damage Hit Points and taking control of the corpse as its new host. The cythnophorian enters the space of its new host, and its former host's corpse falls to the ground in its previous space. Moving to a new host doesn't change the cythnophorian's abilities or movement Speeds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spore Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description: The cythnophorian emits a cloud of toxic spores, exposing all creatures within a 15ft Emanation to creeping death. The cythnophorian can't use Spore Cloud again for 1d4 rounds.
